rationale_one_line: Hermes Agent is an AI-agent engineering platform; VoltAgent's deep-space command-terminal identity (carbon-black + emerald signal green) is the closest brand-design-systems match and lets the numbers in RECEIPT glow as power-on signals.
writing_tone_notes: Terse, build-in-public peer voice. Compressed power blocks. Show the metric, then the consequence. Use contractions where natural. The accent green is reserved for the numbers and the close beat.
do_rules: Lead with the velocity / total metric and let it sit alone for a full beat.
Pair every number with a so-what caption that explains why it matters to a builder.
Reserve the emerald green for big_number numerals and the close.accent — never the whole headline.
Use cut transitions so the metrics land with engineering precision.
Keep the held-subject wordmark anchored bottom-left across every scene.
dont_rules: Don't repeat the X caption's phrasing in any scene. The caption sells velocity + the learning-loop hook; scenes sell the 151k + 200+ specifics.
Don't introduce warm colors. The palette is strictly green + warm neutrals on near-black.
Don't use version numbers in any scene copy (per WRITING_RULES; v0.13.0 is fine in the Why-this-one only).
Don't drop the accent green on a flash or full-bleed surface — it's an accent, never a fill.
